title: OntoKG: Ontology-Oriented Knowledge Graph Construction with Intrinsic-Relational Routing
description: Schema-First知识图谱构建新范式，将ontology/schema作为核心产物而非副产物。提出Intrinsic-Relational Routing划分属性为intrinsic(节点属性)与relational(图边)，使结构决策显式化。Wikidata上构建34.0M节点/61.2M边，schema覆盖率93.3%
key_insights: Schema-First范式：ontology/schema是核心产物而非副产物
Intrinsic-Relational Routing：属性划分为intrinsic(节点)与relational(图边)
Declarative schema(YAML-based)：支持跨存储后端迁移与模块化复用
Agentic LLM workflow：LLM作为schema designer，工具调用迭代优化
